title: Isolith per-crate licensing boundary
decision: keep the split (Don, 2026-10-27): Apache-2.0 for applications and libraries; AGPL-3.0 for the server, the PDM, and the P2P orchestration components.

root_files.LICENSE-AGPL: unmodified GNU Affero General Public License, Version 3

enforcement: scripts/licensing-check.py (leg A: every workspace crate's Cargo.toml [package].license must equal this map and this map must cover every workspace member)

classes.Apache-2.0: applications and libraries. Declared as `license = "Apache-2.0"` in the crate Cargo.toml; full text at LICENSE-APACHE.
classes.AGPL-3.0: the server, the PDM, and the P2P orchestration components. Declared as `license = "AGPL-3.0"` in the crate Cargo.toml; full text at LICENSE-AGPL.

rules: R1 (per-crate boundary): every crate under crates/ is licensed as a whole under exactly one licence, set by its Cargo.toml `license` field and enforced against this map by the CI check.

R2 (library consumed by an AGPL component): a library or application stays Apache-2.0 even when it is linked into or consumed by an AGPL-3.0 crate. The licence of a consumer does not change the licence of the consumed crate. When an AGPL crate links an Apache crate, the combined server work ships under AGPL (the project authors both), while the Apache crate's own grant to third parties stands. Examples in this tree: oep-cgr and oep-step (Apache-2.0) are consumed by oep-worker (AGPL-3.0); oep-geo (Apache-2.0) is consumed by the render worker (AGPL-3.0).

R3 (shared contract crates): a crate whose primary purpose is to define the contract, schema, or state model of the AGPL server/PDM or P2P orchestration runtime takes the licence of the component it contracts. The P2P lane shared contract crates oep-job (job/task spec) and oep-state (distributed job state) are AGPL-3.0. Contract and schema crates of Apache components stay Apache-2.0.
